hunks.baseline: Wherever you went in Hangzhou, people were packed together, repeating rumors they’d heard from someone else as if they were facts, spittle flying from their mouths.
hunks.sol: Wherever you went in Hangzhou, you found people repeating rumors they’d heard from someone else as if they were facts, spittle flying as they talked.

hunks.baseline: They talked about the beauty of a high official’s new concubine—the sort of official said to be powerful enough to knock a bird from the sky. They were furious over the story that he’d squeezed the people dry to buy her expensive jewelry. And when they heard the Embroidered Uniform Guard had already begun investigating, they kept raising their cups in celebration.
hunks.sol: They discussed the beauty of a high official’s new concubine—the sort of official said to be powerful enough to knock a bird from the sky. They grew furious over the story that he’d squeezed the people dry to buy her expensive jewelry. And when they heard the Embroidered Uniform Guard had begun investigating, they raised their cups again and again.

hunks.baseline: “Even so, there’s no one you can count on like the Embroidered Uniform Guard. He may have climbed to the throne after committing such a heinous crime, but at least he knows how to get things done…”
hunks.sol: “Times like this, there’s no one more dependable than the Embroidered Uniform Guard. He may have committed crimes against his own family to take the throne, but at least he knows how to get things done…”

hunks.baseline: “Shh. Shut that reckless mouth of yours. Didn’t you say one of that old man’s sons was in the Embroidered Uniform Guard?”
hunks.sol: “Shh. Shut that reckless mouth of yours. Didn’t you say one of that old official’s sons was in the Embroidered Uniform Guard?”

hunks.baseline: “And he still got caught? Even with connections in the Guard?”
hunks.sol: “And he still got caught? Even with a son in the Guard?”

hunks.baseline: “Oh, that guy. Apparently, he got fired not long ago.”
hunks.sol: “Oh, that one. Apparently, he was dismissed not long ago.”

hunks.baseline: “Don’t know. Maybe he was given some secret assignment. He disappeared about a month ago, then came back a few days ago with his face all swollen.”
hunks.sol: “Don’t know. Maybe he was on some secret assignment. He disappeared about a month ago, then came back a few days ago with his face all swollen.”

hunks.baseline: Poets and scholars seeking inspiration from scenic landmarks. Idlers who’d traveled a thousand *li* to visit Hangzhou, the city of pleasure.
hunks.sol: Poets and scholars seeking inspiration among scenic landmarks. Idlers who’d traveled a thousand *li* to visit Hangzhou, the city of pleasure.

hunks.baseline: Poor scholars quietly sipping liquor after ordering cheap strong liquor and dumplings, and wealthy merchants patting their bulging bellies.
hunks.sol: Poor scholars quietly sipping cheap strong liquor over a plate of dumplings, and wealthy merchants patting their bulging bellies.

hunks.baseline: “But I heard the nuns there are no different from martial artists…”
hunks.sol: “But I heard the nuns there are practically martial artists…”

hunks.baseline: “If you mean the Buddhist nuns at Putuo Temple, there’s no need to worry. They disappeared more than ten years ago, when the imperial capital moved here and the martial artists of Hangzhou were driven out.”
hunks.sol: “If you mean the Buddhist nuns at Putuo Temple, there’s no need to worry. They disappeared more than ten years ago, when the imperial capital moved here and Hangzhou’s martial artists were driven out.”

hunks.baseline: The conversation among the poets and scholars who’d come to Hangzhou to visit its famous sights was in fairly high spirits. The merchants seated nearby, on the other hand, kept pouring liquor down with sour expressions.
hunks.sol: The poets and scholars who’d come to see Hangzhou’s famous sights were in fairly high spirits. The merchants seated nearby, on the other hand, kept pouring down liquor with sour expressions.

hunks.baseline: “Things are looking bad in Sichuan these days. Prices are swinging around so wildly they’re impossible to predict. I’ve taken quite a hit.”
hunks.sol: “Things are looking bad in Sichuan these days. Prices are swinging so wildly they’re impossible to predict. I’ve taken quite a hit.”

hunks.baseline: “Then is that rumor true? That foreign forces are about to pour in from Qinghai Province. They say even the Kunlun Sect, based in Qinghai, is in dire straits.”
hunks.sol: “Then is that rumor true? That foreign forces are about to pour in from Qinghai? They say even the Kunlun Sect, based in Qinghai, is on the brink.”

hunks.baseline: “Foreign forces? They’re nothing but lawless thugs from the martial world—fanatics thoroughly bewitched by demons, at that. They’ve given themselves a fancy new name, but they’ll still get smashed by the Central Plains sects, just like the Demonic Cult did in the past. The Imperial Guard won’t even need to get involved this time.”
hunks.sol: “Foreign forces? They’re nothing but lawless thugs from the martial world—fanatics thoroughly bewitched by demons, at that. They’ve given themselves a fancy new name, but they’ll still get smashed by the Central Plains sects, just like the Demonic Cult did in the past. The Imperial Guards won’t even need to get involved this time.”

hunks.baseline: “Heh. The fanatics weren’t enough, now the barbarians are eyeing the Central Plains too?”
hunks.sol: “Hah. The fanatics weren’t enough, and now the barbarians are eyeing the Central Plains too?”

hunks.baseline: “How should I know? I only heard it secondhand through my connections. Anyway, it’s clear something much bigger is happening than anyone thinks.”
hunks.sol: “How should I know? I only heard it through my connections, several people down the line. Anyway, it’s clear something much bigger is happening than anyone thinks.”

hunks.baseline: The continent was vast. But merchants, whose line of work forced them to keep their ears open, often heard all kinds of information from all kinds of sources.
hunks.sol: The continent was vast. But merchants, whose line of work forced them to keep their ears open, heard all kinds of information through all kinds of channels.

hunks.baseline: Whether those rumors were true or not, it was worth remembering them. Someday, one of them might make you a fortune.
hunks.sol: Whether a rumor was true or not, it was worth remembering. Someday, it might make them a fortune.

hunks.baseline: And just as the inn had grown noisy with all the conversations and clinking cups, someone tossed out a slurred remark.
hunks.sol: Just as the inn had grown noisy with conversation and clinking cups, someone tossed out a slurred remark.

hunks.baseline: “Oh, have you heard the news? They say His Highness, Prince Shangshan, is staying in the imperial palace.”
hunks.sol: “Oh, have you heard? They say His Highness, Prince Shangshan, is staying in the imperial palace.”

hunks.baseline: Silence fell over the inn. Everyone’s gaze had already turned toward the same place.
hunks.sol: Silence fell over the inn. Every gaze turned toward the same place.

hunks.baseline: Startled by the many eyes suddenly fixed on him, a thoroughly drunk middle-aged man stammered.
hunks.sol: Startled by all the eyes suddenly fixed on him, the thoroughly drunk middle-aged man stammered.

hunks.baseline: That was when a few people in the now-quiet inn spoke up.
hunks.sol: Then a few people in the now-quiet inn spoke up.

hunks.baseline: As the questions came flying at him, the middle-aged man realized something was wrong. He felt the alcohol leave his system all at once.
hunks.sol: As the questions came flying at him, the middle-aged man realized something was wrong. He sobered up all at once.

hunks.baseline: “I-I don’t know if it’s true or not. I only heard it somewhere. It’s probably just a rumor.”
hunks.sol: “I-I don’t know if it’s true. I only heard it somewhere. It’s probably just a rumor.”

hunks.baseline: Though he managed to stagger to his feet, he couldn’t take even one step. Something that had dropped from somewhere had stopped him in his tracks.
hunks.sol: Though he managed to stagger to his feet, he couldn’t take a single step. Something dropped from above and stopped him in his tracks.

hunks.baseline: The object hit the floor with a solid thump, landing right in front of the middle-aged man’s feet. At the same time, the leather cord cinched around its opening came loose, spilling its contents.
hunks.sol: It landed right in front of his feet with a solid thump. The leather cord around its opening came loose, spilling the contents.

hunks.baseline: At a glance, there seemed to be more than thirty.
hunks.sol: At a glance, there were more than thirty.

hunks.baseline: Everyone turned around again. No—looked up.
hunks.sol: Everyone turned again. No—looked up.

hunks.baseline: He was stunned by the staggering sum of fifty silver nyang—and by the young scholar who’d tossed it down so casually.
hunks.sol: He was stunned by the sum of fifty silver nyang—and by the young scholar who’d tossed it down so casually.

hunks.baseline: It was more than enough. It was an absurd amount.
hunks.sol: It was more than enough. Far more.

hunks.baseline: But the consequences of the words he’d tossed out so carelessly weighed on him as heavily as that pouch.
hunks.sol: But the possible consequences of the words he’d tossed out so carelessly weighed on him as heavily as that pouch.

hunks.baseline: The middle-aged man grew even more uneasy at the young scholar’s answer, but he couldn’t let a chance to change his life slip away.
hunks.sol: The young scholar’s answer made the middle-aged man even more uneasy, but he couldn’t let a chance to change his life slip away.

hunks.baseline: Even this vast imperial capital, the center of the world, had its share of poor people. For a middle-aged man like him, fifty silver nyang meant a whole new life.
hunks.sol: Even this vast imperial capital, the center of the world, had its share of poor people. For one of them, fifty silver nyang meant a whole new life.

hunks.baseline: Having made up his mind, the middle-aged man hurriedly gathered up the spilled silver and stuffed it back into the pouch before anyone could steal it. He swallowed, then spoke to the young scholar.
hunks.sol: Having made up his mind, he hurriedly gathered the spilled silver and stuffed it back into the pouch before anyone could steal it. He swallowed, then spoke to the young scholar.

hunks.baseline: “Near dawn, I was hanging around a gambling den when I heard the story. They said that more than a few hundred members of the Embroidered Uniform Guard had entered through the North Gate a few days ago. Even in the imperial capital, the streets were guarded more heavily than usual, and the atmosphere was strange that day.”
hunks.sol: “Near dawn, I was hanging around a gambling den when I heard the story. They said several hundred members of the Embroidered Uniform Guard had entered through the North Gate a few days ago. Even for the imperial capital, the guards along the main road and the atmosphere were unusual that day.”

hunks.baseline: “A few sharp-eyed fellows thought something was off, so they risked drawing a reprimand and snuck a look. Would you believe it? Those terrifying guards had surrounded a single carriage so tightly you could barely see it.”
hunks.sol: “A few sharp-eyed fellows thought something was off, so they risked a scolding and snuck a look. Would you believe it? Those terrifying guards had surrounded a single carriage so tightly you could barely see it.”

hunks.baseline: “They said they saw it with their own two eyes. A boy’s face appeared at the window—he looked extraordinary at a glance. They said he was definitely the very Prince Shangshan everyone’s heard about…”
hunks.sol: “They said they saw him with their own eyes. A boy’s face appeared at the window—he looked extraordinary at a glance. They said he was definitely the Prince Shangshan everyone’s heard about…”

hunks.baseline: The young scholar cut the man off and continued.
hunks.sol: The young scholar cut him off and continued.

hunks.baseline: “It’s been more than ten years since His Highness, Prince Shangshan, left the capital. He was very young even then, and even after all these years, he still isn’t fifteen. How could someone who spends his nights hanging around a gambling den recognize His Highness’s face?”
hunks.sol: “It’s been more than ten years since His Highness, Prince Shangshan, left the capital. He was very young even then, and even now he isn’t fifteen. How could someone who spends his nights hanging around a gambling den recognize His Highness’s face?”

hunks.baseline: “Perhaps. But there must have been another reason he made that guess. I’ve already paid you well. You should tell me everything you saw and heard.”
hunks.sol: “Perhaps. But there must have been another reason for that guess. I’ve already paid you well. Tell me everything you saw and heard, without leaving anything out.”

hunks.baseline: A noble, yet pitiful, man.
hunks.sol: Noble, yet pitiable.

hunks.baseline: An unfortunate member of the imperial family, exiled to Shanxi Province in a far-off land after losing his entire family to his older brother, who’d defied the bonds of kinship.
hunks.sol: An unfortunate member of the imperial family, exiled in all but name to far-off Shanxi Province after losing his entire family to an older brother who’d defied the bonds of kinship.

hunks.baseline: After more than ten years—and in secret, surrounded by the Embroidered Uniform Guard.
hunks.sol: After more than ten years—and secretly, surrounded by the Embroidered Uniform Guard.

hunks.baseline: “At first, I thought the same thing as you, Young Master. How could it be true? How could the likes of you recognize His Highness, Prince Shangshan? Why would someone who’d spent more than ten years in the provinces suddenly come to the capital? That sort of thing. But…”
hunks.sol: “At first, I thought the same thing as you, Young Master. How could it be true? How could the likes of him recognize His Highness, Prince Shangshan? Why would someone who’d spent more than ten years in the provinces suddenly come to the capital? That sort of thing. But…”

hunks.baseline: “That guy jumped up and said, ‘The Emperor—no, His Majesty the Emperor—has had an heir. Of course his younger brother, His Highness Prince Shangshan, would come. He was surely invited to the celebration that’s about to be held.’”
hunks.sol: “That fellow jumped up and said, ‘The Emperor—no, His Majesty the Emperor—is expecting an heir. Of course his younger brother, His Highness Prince Shangshan, would come. He was surely invited to the celebration that’s about to be held.’”

hunks.baseline: A few sharp intakes of breath broke the silence, and the dim lamplight fell on people frozen in place.
hunks.sol: Sharp intakes of breath broke the silence, and the dim lamplight fell on people frozen in place.

hunks.baseline: The young scholar’s face had gone stiff beyond words, too.
hunks.sol: The young scholar’s face had gone rigid, too.

hunks.baseline: “Yes. He didn’t know if it was the Empress or one of the concubines, but he said she was definitely pregnant.”
hunks.sol: “Yes. He didn’t know whether it was the Empress or one of the concubines, but he said she was definitely pregnant.”

hunks.baseline: The young scholar’s eyes sank into shadow.
hunks.sol: The young scholar’s gaze darkened.

hunks.baseline: Some of the more than a hundred customers in the inn looked the same.
hunks.sol: Some of the more than a hundred customers in the inn reacted the same way.

hunks.baseline: The people biting their lips to hide their shock were poets, scholars, and merchants. Unlike the middle-aged man and a few other simpletons, they understood exactly what those words might mean.
hunks.sol: The ones biting their lips to hide their shock were poets, scholars, and merchants. Unlike the middle-aged man and a few other simpletons, they understood exactly what those words might mean.

hunks.baseline: The thought alone filled them with fear.
hunks.sol: The thought alone frightened them.

hunks.baseline: A new heir to an Emperor who’d long been without one. And the return of Prince Shangshan, the only direct member of the imperial family to survive the bloodshed more than a decade ago.
hunks.sol: A new heir for an Emperor who’d long had none. And the return of Prince Shangshan, the only direct member of the imperial family to survive the bloodshed more than a decade ago.

hunks.baseline: A silent scream rang in their heads. Their backs were already slick with cold sweat as they sensed the danger.
hunks.sol: A silent scream rang in their heads. Cold sweat had already soaked their backs.

hunks.baseline: Whether the rumor was true or not, this was a story they should never have heard in the first place.
hunks.sol: Whether the rumor was true or not, this was a story they should never have heard.

hunks.baseline: At that moment, they felt as if they were standing at the edge of a thousand-*zhang* cliff, one misstep from a fall they could never climb back from.
hunks.sol: They felt as if they were standing at the edge of a sheer cliff, where one misstep would send them plunging too far to ever climb back.

hunks.baseline: Unlike the middle-aged man, who was happily counting his silver, and the few others who had yet to grasp the severity of the situation.
hunks.sol: The middle-aged man, meanwhile, was happily counting his silver. He and a few others hadn’t grasped the danger at all.

hunks.baseline: “So His Majesty has finally had an heir. What a blessing for the whole country.”
hunks.sol: “So His Majesty is finally expecting an heir. What a blessing for the whole country.”

hunks.baseline: “What blessing? What blessing? The child will inherit the blood of a man who broke the bonds of kinship to take the throne—”
hunks.sol: “What blessing? The child will inherit the blood of a man who broke the bonds of kinship to take the throne—”

hunks.baseline: “Please, just shut your mouth. Do you have three or four lives to spare? You want to get me killed too? If someone reports us, we’re all finished.”
hunks.sol: “Please, just shut your mouth. Do you have three or four lives to spare? Do you want to get me killed too? If someone reports us, we’re all finished.”

hunks.baseline: “If you’re so afraid of people overhearing, go hide at home. People have always cursed the ruler where he can’t hear them. The Embroidered Uniform Guard aren’t ghosts. How often are you even going to run into them? Honestly.”
hunks.sol: “If you’re so afraid of people overhearing, go hide at home. People have always cursed the ruler where he can’t hear them. The Embroidered Uniform Guard aren’t ghosts. What are the chances we’ll run into them? Honestly.”

hunks.baseline: “What would a nobody like me know? I just hope he stays in the capital from now on. He suffered such terrible things as a child. Who knows what he’s been through? It’s about time he had somewhere peaceful to live.”
hunks.sol: “What would a nobody like me know? I just hope he stays in the capital from now on. He suffered such terrible things as a child. Who knows what that’s done to him? It’s about time he could live somewhere in peace.”

hunks.baseline: Words were always embellished and exaggerated, and people always heard what they wanted to believe.
hunks.sol: Stories always grew in the telling, and people believed what they wanted to believe.

hunks.baseline: The unbelievable rumor that had come from the middle-aged man’s mouth had already become a fact backed by solid evidence. Some of the people who’d been afraid from the start moved their trembling legs and crossed the now noisy inn.
hunks.sol: The incredible rumor the middle-aged man had passed on had already become, in the minds of the crowd, a fact backed by solid evidence. A few of those who’d sensed the danger from the start forced their trembling legs to carry them across the noisy inn.

hunks.baseline: To escape a fire too great to contain and survive.
hunks.sol: Some meant to escape before they were caught in a fire they couldn’t survive.

hunks.baseline: Or to confirm the truth of this information and use it.
hunks.sol: Others meant to confirm the information and use it.

hunks.baseline: But when they finally reached the entrance, they realized they’d stepped into a swamp they could no longer escape.
hunks.sol: But when they reached the entrance, they realized they’d stepped into a mire they could no longer escape.

hunks.baseline: At the subdued voice, a dozen shadows stepped forward at once, blocking the old doorway.
hunks.sol: At the low voice, the shadows blocking the old doorway stepped forward together.

hunks.baseline: In the eyes of those hurrying to leave the inn were ten men with bamboo hats pulled low—and, flashing between their wind-cloaks, golden armor.
hunks.sol: Those hurrying to leave saw ten men with bamboo hats pulled low—and golden armor flashing beneath their wind-cloaks.

hunks.baseline: At those three words, which escaped someone’s lips like a scream, the inn froze over.
hunks.sol: The words escaped someone’s lips like a scream, and the inn froze.

hunks.baseline: “That was a truly interesting story. Interesting enough to make fifty silver nyang worthwhile.”
hunks.sol: “That was a truly interesting story. Well worth fifty silver nyang.”

hunks.baseline: The middle-aged man’s shouts were already out of the young scholar’s mind.
hunks.sol: The young scholar paid no attention to his shouts.

hunks.baseline: The young scholar—no, the Embroidered Uniform Guard captain—addressed his subordinates, who were blocking the inn’s entrance.
hunks.sol: The young scholar—no, the hundred-household officer of the Embroidered Uniform Guard—addressed his subordinates at the entrance in a mild voice.

hunks.baseline: With a crisp salute, ten golden figures raced in every direction.
hunks.sol: With a sharp salute, ten golden figures raced in every direction.

hunks.baseline: Every one of them was a martial arts master at Supreme First Rate or Peak.
hunks.sol: Every one of them was a master whose martial arts had reached Supreme First Rate or Peak.

hunks.baseline: Shouts and tearful pleas burst out from every corner. It took no more than an instant for the cries of those trying to flee or fight back to drown them out.
hunks.sol: Shouts and tearful pleas burst out across the inn. An instant later, the screams of those trying to flee or fight back drowned them out.

hunks.baseline: Amid the crashes ringing through the inn, the Embroidered Uniform Guard captain leaped from the second-floor railing and landed lightly on the ground. He patted the trembling middle-aged man on the shoulder.
hunks.sol: Amid the crashes, the officer pushed off the second-floor railing and landed lightly beside the trembling middle-aged man. He patted him on the shoulder.

hunks.baseline: “Now, it’s noisy here. Let’s move somewhere else and talk. We’ll discuss everything else you know, who told you that bullshit, and who else has heard it.”
hunks.sol: “Now, it’s noisy here. Let’s go somewhere else and talk. You can tell me what else you know, who fed you that bullshit, and who else has heard it.”

hunks.baseline: He didn’t bother to tell the man.
hunks.sol: He didn’t bother to tell the man what would pay for his story this time.

hunks.baseline: This time, he would pay for the story with something other than silver.
And it would shine like silver, yet be incomparably sharper.
hunks.sol: It wouldn’t be silver. But it would shine just as brightly—and be far sharper.

hunks.baseline: After hearing the report, the Emperor remained silent for a long time, even after the messenger had withdrawn. Only when one person remained nearby did he finally speak.
hunks.sol: After hearing the report, the Emperor remained silent for a long time, even after the messenger withdrew. Only when one other person remained did he finally speak.

hunks.baseline: Between the dense strings of pearls and the gauzy silks drifting all around, someone answered.
hunks.sol: From between the dense strings of pearls and the silks drifting around them, someone answered.

hunks.baseline: “Someone must have deliberately spread the rumor.”
hunks.sol: “Someone must have spread the rumor deliberately.”

hunks.baseline: “Who’s behind it?”
hunks.sol: “Who?”

hunks.baseline: “Isn’t it obvious? If not the East Depot, then Jin Taekyung, the Blazing Flame Divine Dragon. Or… both.”
hunks.sol: “Isn’t it obvious? The East Depot, Jin Taekyung—the Blazing Flame Divine Dragon—or… both.”

hunks.baseline: “They joined forces?”
hunks.sol: “They’ve joined forces?”

hunks.baseline: “I regret it a little. I wonder if it was wise of me to let Jin Taekyung into the imperial palace just because I listened to you.”
hunks.sol: “I’m beginning to regret it. Perhaps I shouldn’t have listened to you and let Jin Taekyung into the imperial palace.”

hunks.baseline: “Did the person who sent you to me predict a situation like this, too?”
hunks.sol: “Did the person who sent you to me foresee this, too?”

hunks.baseline: That audacity, so impossible to fathom. His strength and conviction.
hunks.sol: Jin Taekyung’s audacity was impossible to fathom. So were his martial prowess and his convictions.

hunks.baseline: Regardless of their respective positions, Jin Taekyung’s appearance the other day had nearly made even the Emperor laugh out loud.
hunks.sol: Whatever their respective positions, the Jin Taekyung he’d seen the day before had been enough to make even the Emperor let out an incredulous laugh.

hunks.baseline: “Of course. If it were easy, he wouldn’t have been a thorn in our side for more than ten years. But the Great Nation cannot stand firm while he remains. We must do it.”
hunks.sol: “Of course. If it were easy, he wouldn’t have been a thorn in our side for more than ten years. But the Great Nation cannot be set right until he’s gone. You must see it done.”

hunks.baseline: In place of an answer, a faint breeze from somewhere caressed the silks.
hunks.sol: In place of an answer, a faint breeze stirred the silks.

hunks.baseline: When the Emperor realized that the person who’d been there only moments ago had vanished, he gave a bitter smile and muttered,
hunks.sol: The Emperor realized that the person who’d been there only moments ago had vanished. He gave a bitter smile and muttered,

hunks.baseline: “The rumor’s already out. There’s no point hiding it now. We’ll just have to make it true.”
hunks.sol: “The rumor’s already out. There’s no point trying to hide it now. We’ll have to make it true.”

hunks.baseline: And so began the great celebration commemorating the birth of a new heir to inherit the Great Nation.
hunks.sol: It was the moment that heralded a grand celebration of the birth of a new heir to inherit the Great Nation.
